model_claims.text: Adds a `retries` attribute to `MaxRetryError`, containing the exhausted `Retry` object so that its `history` of individual attempts can be inspected after the exception is raised.
model_claims.source_quote: Adds a `retries` attribute to `MaxRetryError`, containing the exhausted `Retry` object so that its `history` of individual attempts (method, url, error, status, redirect_location) can be inspected after the exception is raised.

model_claims.text: `MaxRetryError.__init__` gains an optional `retries: Retry | None = None` keyword parameter, stored as `self.retries`, defaulting to `None` and thus not changing existing behavior.
model_claims.source_quote: * `MaxRetryError.__init__` gains an optional `retries: Retry | None = None` keyword parameter, stored as `self.retries`.
